theater: 波希米亞與易北河戰線

battle.name: 三十年戰爭
battle.theater: 波希米亞與易北河戰線
battle.brief: 一六一八年五月二十三日布拉格擲窗事件掀開三十年戰爭，波希米亞王冠戰之後，萊茵、易北河與北德戰線相繼轉動。西班牙大方陣的長槍兵是全軍骨幹，火槍隊退到槍陣後方裝填再頂回前線，兩者交替掩護撐住陣腳。瑞典人改用輕炮與線形縱深破解槍陣，到一六四三年洛雷一役，這支方陣連同它的長槍正式崩解。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方並非單一對手，而是以哈布斯堡家族為核心的兩套君主國體系，加上持續二十九年、陣容多次改組的聯盟。哈布斯堡一方包括西班牙王國及其布魯塞爾政府，駐尼德蘭的西班牙軍隊先後由奧伯根大公、斯皮諾拉伯爵指揮；德意志皇帝斐迪南二世以奧地利世襲領地為基地，一六二三年正式即位後掌握帝國，並在天主教聯盟成立前依賴西班牙輸出的稅銀維持戰爭。天主教聯盟由巴伐利亞選侯馬西米利安一世率領，加上教會邦與若干南德諸侯，帝國軍隊則由戰事委員會調度軍費與徵召。反對方起於一六一八年布拉格擲窗事件後的波希米亞等級聯盟，推選巴伐利亞選侯腓特烈五世為波希米亞國王，以布拉格民兵、波希米亞與德意志新教傭兵組成軍隊；德意志境內另有新教聯盟，包括薩克斯選侯約翰·喬治一世、不倫瑞克的克里斯蒂安、薩克斯-魏瑪的恩斯特等。一六二○年丹麥-挪威國王克里斯蒂安四世以新教信仰與領土糾紛出兵，一六三○年瑞典在古斯塔夫二世阿道夫率領下登陸波美拉尼亞，以一萬三千人左右的野戰軍為核心，配合同盟的德意志與黑森-卡塞爾傭兵。法國由黎塞留主持大局，先以補助款資助荷蘭與瑞典，一六三五年正式對西班牙開戰，由孔代親王、恩讓公爵與朗索伯爵率法軍作戰。荷蘭共和國自一五六八年起與西班牙對抗，荷蘭陸軍同時投入西班牙尼德蘭戰線；英國在詹姆士一世與查理一世治下以補助款與遠征隊間接參與，一六二九年白金漢公爵的遠征與一六三○年拉羅謝爾之圍都告失利。波蘭-立陶宛聯邦兩度介入，哈布斯堡在匈牙利對付奧斯曼土耳其時需要波蘭協助，聯邦干預又牽動東線。瑞士邦聯嚴守中立，是三方都倚重的存糧與借貸市場所在。
countriesEn: The belligerents were not a single pair of adversaries but two Habsburg-centred monarchic systems together with alliances that were repeatedly reshaped across twenty-nine years. The Habsburg side comprised the Kingdom of Spain and its Brussels government, the Spanish armies in the Netherlands being commanded first by the Archduke Albert and later by Count Spinola; the German emperor Ferdinand II, based in his Austrian hereditary lands and firmly established as emperor after 1623; and the Catholic League led by Elector Maximilian I of Bavaria together with the ecclesiastical states and several southern German princes, while the imperial war treasury administered finance and recruiting. The opposing side grew out of the Bohemian Estates alliance formed after the Defenestration of Prague in 1618, which elected the Palatine elector Frederick V as King of Bohemia and raised an army of Prague militia together with Bohemian and German Protestant mercenaries; within the Empire the Protestant Union included the elector John George I of Saxony, Christian of Brunswick and Ernest of Saxe-Weimar. In 1620 King Christian IV of Denmark-Norway entered the war on grounds of religion and territorial dispute, and in 1630 Sweden under Gustavus Adolphus landed in Pomerania with a field army of about thirteen thousand men, supported by German allies and troops from Hesse-Kassel. France, directed by Richelieu, first subsidised the Dutch and the Swedes and from 1635 fought Spain openly, with armies commanded by the Prince of Condé, the Duke of Enghien and Count Rantzau. The Dutch Republic, at war with Spain since 1568, fought simultaneously in the Spanish Netherlands; England under James I and Charles I took part indirectly through subsidies and expeditions, the Duke of Buckingham's campaign of 1629 and the siege of La Rochelle in 1630 both ending in failure. The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth intervened twice, needed by the Habsburgs to hold the Ottomans in Hungary, and its intervention in turn reshaped the eastern front. The Swiss Confederacy kept a strict neutrality and served as the grain and credit market on which all parties drew.
people: 關鍵人物先集中在布拉格。一六一八年五月二十三日，波希米亞新教貴族在馬特耶·圖恩與瓦茨拉夫·布多韋茨率領下，把皇帝任命的布拉格總督馬丁尼茨與斯拉瓦塔兩人連同祕書從市政廳窗口扔下，這就是開戰的訊號。波希米亞等級會議隨後推舉巴伐利亞選侯腓特烈五世，一六一九年九月十四日在布拉格加冕；帝國這邊則由斐迪南二世於一六一九年即位，並把巴伐利亞選侯馬西米利安一世推到天主教聯盟前台。戰場上最長的指揮官是蒂利伯爵，他自一六二○年起統率帝國與聯盟軍，在白山、溫普芬、盧特三役連勝，最後在雷恩河畔受重傷，一六三二年七月病逝；一六二五年起受皇帝委託、以自掏腰包方式招募大軍的是華倫斯坦，他於一六三○年被解職，一六三一年再度出山。荷蘭與西班牙的戰線由莫里茨親王與其弟腓特烈·亨利交替統兵，斯皮諾拉伯爵在西班牙尼德蘭打出一六二四年布雷達圍城戰這樣的長期攻堅。北方的古斯塔夫二世阿道夫一六三○年率軍入德，宰相奧克森提耶納在後方主持軍費，亞斯·班納與古斯塔夫·霍恩分任左右兩翼指揮；一六三二年十一月十六日盧岑一戰他陣亡，瑞典軍隨即失去重心。荷、法兩國的介入由黎塞留推動，孔代親王與恩讓公爵自一六三五至三六年在法蘭西亞作戰，英國方面則是查理一世與白金漢公爵。德意志諸侯中，薩克斯-魏瑪的伯納德、勃蘭登堡的喬治·威廉與拿騷家系的莫里茨父子先後投入戰局。
peopleEn: The decisive figures first cluster in Prague. On 23 May 1618 the Bohemian Protestant nobles, led by Matěj Thurn and Václav Budovec of Budov, threw the emperor's appointees, the Prague governors Jaroslav Bořita of Martinice and Vilém Slavata of Chlum, together with their secretary, out of the town hall window; that was the signal for war. The Bohemian estates then elected the Palatine elector Frederick V, crowned in Prague on 14 September 1619, while on the imperial side Ferdinand II acceded to the throne in 1619 and pushed the Bavarian elector Maximilian I to the front of the Catholic League. The longest-serving battlefield commander was Count Johann Tserclaes of Tilly, who led imperial and league troops from 1620 and won at White Mountain, Wimpfen and Lutter in succession, was mortally wounded on the banks of the Lech and died in July 1632; from 1625 the emperor entrusted the raising of a large army to Albrecht von Wallenstein, who paid for it out of his own pocket, was dismissed in 1630 and returned in 1631. The Dutch and Spanish theatre was commanded in turn by Maurice of Orange and his brother Frederick Henry, while Count Spinola conducted the long siege of Breda in the Spanish Netherlands in 1624. In the north, Gustavus Adolphus brought his army into Germany in 1630, with Chancellor Oxenstierna administering the war finance behind the front and Johan Banér and Gustav Horn commanding the two wings; he was killed at Lützen on 16 November 1632 and the Swedish army promptly lost its centre. The involvement of the Dutch and the French was driven by Richelieu, with the Prince of Condé and the Duke of Enghien campaigning in Franche-Comté from 1635 to 1636, and on the English side Charles I and the Duke of Buckingham. Among the German princes, Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar, George William of Brandenburg and Maurice of Nassau and his son entered the war in turn.
kits: 這場戰爭的裝備核心是長槍與火槍的組合。長槍是西班牙大方陣的骨幹，槍桿多由白蠟木或松木削成，全長五至六公尺，槍頭為菱形鋼錐，分前導槍與突進槍兩種：前導槍的槍身較短，槍尖加寬成十字形，用來把敵方火槍手推離射界；突進槍更長更輕，斜舉時可以穿過己方火槍隊的頭頂伸出去。火槍手配備火繩式火槍，槍身帶喇叭口槍管，配十二發分裝的皮帶彈藥盒與火繩支架；一六二○年代起，簧式擊錘槍與燧發槍逐步取代火繩槍，槍上改裝擊錘，保險與擊錘同時待擊，發射後整槍不必重複點火，可以維持射速。一支標準西班牙大方陣步兵約三千人，其中長槍兵、火槍手、刀盾兵各約一千人，騎兵與步兵的比例常見一比三至一比四。長槍兵多備護頸與皮甲，晚期才出現整片胸甲；火槍手戴輕盔，後來改用厚布外衣以便隨身攜帶彈藥；刀盾兵穿半甲，配直刀與刺刀。騎兵分為全甲胸甲騎兵與輕裝馬槍手，槍兵亦有乘馬者，長矛與蝶形槍矛並行。炮兵方面，野戰砲從十二磅到三十二磅不等，一六三○年代帝國在阿爾德林根指導下大量造炮，並發展出可在戰場上快速佈置的輕砲。攻城則依賴稜堡體系的要塞、坑道、壕溝與突擊牆，器械包括破城槌、雲梯與攻城塔。馬匹以軍馬、騾與牛車供應，麵包車隊與西班牙之路構成補給線。
kitsEn: The equipment core of this war was the combination of pike and musket. The pike was the backbone of the Spanish tercio: the shaft was usually shaved from whitewood or pine, five to six metres long, with a diamond-shaped steel head, and came in two forms, the leading pike with a shorter shaft and a cross-shaped head used to push enemy musketeers out of their firing arc, and the charging pike, longer and lighter, which could be levelled over the heads of the musketeers in its own ranks. Musketeers carried matchlock muskets with flared barrels, a bandolier holding twelve charges in separate boxes and a match holder; from the 1620s snaphaunce and flintlock pieces gradually replaced them, the lock being arranged so that cock and frizzen stood ready together, allowing a musketeer to fire without relighting and to keep up his rate. A standard Spanish tercio of infantry numbered about three thousand, roughly a thousand pikemen, a thousand musketeers and a thousand swordsmen, with cavalry commonly in a proportion of one to three or one to four of infantry. Pikemen wore gorgets and leather armour, full breastplates appearing only late in the war; musketeers wore light helmets and later a heavy cloth coat so that ammunition could be carried on the body; swordsmen fought in half-armour with straight swords and rapiers. The cavalry divided into fully armoured cuirassiers and lighter horse lancers, some pikemen rode to the field, and long lances and butterfly-headed pikes were used side by side. On the artillery side field guns ran from twelve to thirty-two pounds; in the 1630s the Empire built guns in large numbers under Count von Aldringen and developed light pieces that could be brought into action quickly on the field. Siege work depended on the bastioned system of fortresses, saps, trenches and breaches, with hammers, ladders and siege towers among the tools. Horses, mules and ox carts supplied the armies, and the bread convoy and the Spanish Road made up the lines of supply.
tactics: 西班牙大方陣的戰術核心是三段配置：最前是稀疏排列的火槍射手，其後是縱深二十排的長槍方塊，最後是刀盾兵預備隊，槍陣一旦受衝擊便由後方把射手換上來。火槍隊以按班射擊與按列射擊兩種節奏運作：按列射擊是整排一齊開火後伏地退到後排裝填，再由後排頂上來；按班射擊則以小組輪流開火，用來突破騷擾與煙幕的效果。當面臨密集射擊時，士兵會縮成蝌蚪式的散兵線，再重組成天鵝頸的縱深，盡量縮短正面寬度。與槍陣對抗的標準套路是以火槍退長槍、以騎兵破火槍、以長槍抗騎兵，西班牙人自己也用這套反制別人。瑞典人則把長槍隊縮成正面窄而厚的方陣，兩翼配上輕炮與火槍，採用線形縱深與交替後射的反向行軍戰術，讓前排射完退回後排裝填而火力不斷，並在多兵種之間以迂迴的梯形推進取代一次總攻。戰場上還有兩種專門兵種：一是龍騎兵，把火槍手騎在馬上作戰，兼有火槍射程與騎兵速度；二是乘馬的長槍手，衝鋒時仍用長槍的刺與撞。攻城與野戰同樣依賴紀律：圍城要拉出綿長的圍城線與野戰堡壘，攻方靠坑道、突擊牆與火藥爆破，最後由步槍手在缺口上排成方陣。防守方則善用車陣與帳幕堡壘，把火槍與火盆疊成活的牆。糧道與駐紮同樣決定勝負：西班牙軍用西班牙之路沿堤道狹路行軍，糧車隊必須護送，否則全軍在幾日內便會飢餓。
tacticsEn: The tactical heart of the Spanish tercio was a three-part order of battle: skirmishing musketeers in front, a pike block twenty ranks deep behind them, and swordsmen in reserve at the rear, so that when the pike was pressed the musketeers could be rotated in from behind. Musketeer fire worked on two rhythms, firing by ranks and firing by files: firing by ranks meant a whole rank discharging at once, then lying down and withdrawing to the rear to reload while the next rank came forward; firing by files had small groups shoot in turn, which carried better against harassment and smoke. Under heavy incoming fire the soldiers would contract into a loose line of tadpoles and then re-form in a deep column like a swan's neck, so as to narrow the front as much as possible. The standard answer to a pike was fire to break pike, cavalry to break musket, and pike to hold off cavalry, and the Spaniards used the same formula against their enemies. The Swedes instead compressed the pikemen into thick blocks narrow in front, put light guns and musketeers on the wings, and fought in linear depth using a countermarch in which the front rank withdrew to reload at the rear while the fire never ceased, replacing one grand assault with successive oblique advances in echelon between the different arms. Two specialist troops appear on the field: dragoons, musketeers mounted on horses who combined the range of the musket with the speed of cavalry, and mounted pikemen who kept the point and the shove of the pike when they charged. Siege and field alike demanded discipline: a siege required a long circumvallation and field fortifications, the attacker working by sap, breach and gunpowder, with musketeers finally drawn up in blocks at the gap; the defender relied on wagon laagers and entrenchments, stacking muskets and fires into a living wall. Supply lines and billeting decided as much as battles: the Spanish army marched by the Spanish Road along narrow dike tracks, the bread convoys had to be escorted, and without them the whole army starved within days.
data: 有根據的數字並不難找。西班牙大方陣步兵典型編制為三千人，長槍兵、火槍手、刀盾兵各一千人，騎兵比例一比三至一比四；長槍長五至六公尺，火槍槍身約一點四公尺。一六二○年白山一役，帝國與聯盟軍約二萬至二萬五千人對波希米亞聯軍約一萬二千至一萬六千人，敗方陣亡約二三千人、被俘約四千人。一六二二年溫普芬一役，蒂利以約二萬二千至二萬五千人擊敗巴登-杜拉赫與曼斯菲爾德聯軍約一萬二千至一萬五千人，巴登選侯陣亡。一六二六年盧特一役，克里斯蒂安四世約二萬人（含數千德意志傭兵）對蒂利約二萬二千至二萬五千人，丹麥國王退往慕尼黑求援。古斯塔夫二世阿道夫一六三○年入德時帶一萬三千人與數十門炮；一六三一年布萊滕費爾德一役，瑞典與德意志盟軍約一萬三千至一萬六千人對蒂利約二萬至二萬五千人，帝國軍傷亡約六千人，炮兵全失；一六三二年雷恩一役，瑞典約二萬至二萬五千人對蒂利一萬六千至二萬人，蒂利重傷；同年盧岑一役，瑞典約一萬三千至一萬九千人對帝國聯軍約二萬一千至二萬三千人，兩軍各損約三分之一，古斯塔夫陣亡。一六三四年諾德林根一役，帝國-西班牙聯軍約二萬五千至三萬人對瑞典聯軍約一萬六千至一萬八千人，瑞典軍被俘約五千人。一六四三年洛雷一役，法軍約二萬一千至二萬三千人對西班牙軍約一萬八千至一萬九千人，西班牙大方陣被摧毀，約八千人陣亡、七千至八千人被俘，軍中全體重裝步兵近乎覆沒。戰爭總死亡人數各家估計差距極大，一般落在四百五十萬至八百萬之間；德意志各邦人口由一七千萬至一八千萬降至約一千萬至一千二百萬，約三分之一的人口消失，原因主要是疾病、飢荒與徵集。火繩槍在理想狀態每分鐘可發射十次以上，實戰持續射擊多為每分鐘一至兩發；換上簧式與燧發機括後，射手可以安全地保持射擊陣線。
dataEn: Grounded figures are not hard to find. The typical Spanish tercio of infantry numbered three thousand, a thousand pikemen, a thousand musketeers and a thousand swordsmen, with cavalry at one to three or one to four of infantry; the pike was five to six metres long and the musket barrel about one and a half metres. At White Mountain in 1620 an imperial and league army of some twenty to twenty-five thousand faced a Bohemian confederate force of roughly twelve to sixteen thousand, and the defeated side lost two or three thousand dead and about four thousand captured. At Wimpfen in 1622 Tilly's some twenty-two to twenty-five thousand defeated the Baden-Durlach and Mansfeld league of about twelve to fifteen thousand, and the Baden elector was killed. At Lutter in 1626 Christian IV's roughly twenty thousand men, including several thousand German mercenaries, faced Tilly's twenty-two to twenty-five thousand, and the Danish king was driven back to Munich to seek help. Gustavus Adolphus entered Germany in 1630 with thirteen thousand men and a number of guns; at Breitenfeld in 1631 thirteen to sixteen thousand Swedes and German allies faced twenty to twenty-five thousand under Tilly, the imperial army losing about six thousand and its artillery entirely; at Rain in 1632 twenty to twenty-five thousand Swedes faced sixteen to twenty thousand under Tilly, who was badly wounded; at Lützen in the same year thirteen to nineteen thousand Swedes faced twenty-one to twenty-three thousand imperial and league troops, each side losing about a third of its army and Gustavus falling. At Nördlingen in 1634 twenty-five to thirty thousand imperial and Spanish troops faced sixteen to eighteen thousand Swedes and German allies, of whom about five thousand were captured. At Rocroi in 1643 twenty-one to twenty-three thousand French faced eighteen to nineteen thousand Spaniards, the Spanish tercio being destroyed with about eight thousand dead and seven to eight thousand captured, the entire body of armoured infantry in the army practically annihilated. Estimates of total deaths in the war vary enormously and generally fall between four and a half million and eight million; the population of the German states fell from something like seventeen or eighteen million to around ten or twelve million, roughly a third of the people disappearing, mainly through disease, famine and conscription. A matchlock musket could theoretically fire more than ten rounds a minute, though sustained rates in battle were nearer one or two shots a minute; with snaphaunce and flintlocks a musketeer could hold his firing line without lighting a match.
cause: 直接起因是布拉格的一場衝突，但根源在十一年前。神圣羅馬帝國一五五五年的奧格斯堡和約只解決了一半問題：教會土地沒有歸還，新教諸侯在帝國議會中的席位與帝國司法改革懸而未決，天主教與新教兩套軍備在帝國境內對峙，荷蘭獨立戰爭又把西班牙拖在低地。西班牙在財務崩潰後仍靠美洲白銀維持帝國的戰爭能力，這套以借貸與外包僱傭兵為主的體系，使哈布斯堡得以在巴伐利亞主導天主教聯盟，並在一六一八年把矛頭指向波希米亞。波希米亞新教貴族享有陛下詔書確立的自治權，卻在虔敬派受迫害、教堂與市鎮被改宗等問題上與布拉格總督衝突不斷。皇帝斐迪南二世身兼波希米亞國王，既不願放棄王位，也無法約束聯盟盟友。一六一八年五月二十三日，馬丁尼茨與斯拉瓦塔被擲出市政廳窗口，等於向帝國宣戰；同年九月腓特烈五世接受波希米亞王位，衝突便從帝國內部事務升級為國際衝突。白山一役之後，帝國援引宗教遷移敕令試圖收回新教諸侯的教會土地，進一步把北德與萊茵的新教諸侯推向瑞典；瑞典介入是天主教聯盟反對的結果，法國在一六三五年公開參戰則把戰爭變成哈布斯堡西班牙與法國的歐洲霸權之爭。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a confrontation in Prague, but the roots lay eleven years earlier. The Peace of Augsburg of 1555 had settled only half the problem: church lands were not restored, the seats of the Protestant princes in the imperial diet and the reform of imperial justice remained open questions, Catholic and Protestant military forces faced each other inside the Empire, and the Dutch revolt kept Spain bogged down in the Low Countries. Even after its financial collapse Spain sustained the wars of the Empire with American silver, and this system of borrowing and of contracting out the work to mercenary companies let the Habsburgs lead the Catholic League in Bavaria and turn on Bohemia in 1618. The Bohemian Protestant nobility held the autonomy established by the Letter of Majesty, yet it was in constant conflict with the Prague governors over the persecution of the Utraquists, the closing of churches and the forcible re-conversion of towns. The emperor Ferdinand II was King of Bohemia as well, unwilling to give up the crown and equally unable to restrain his allies in the League. On 23 May 1618 the throwing of Martinic and Slavata out of the town hall window amounted to a declaration of war against the Empire; when Frederick V accepted the Bohemian crown that September, the conflict was raised from an internal dispute of the Empire into a European one. After the victory at White Mountain the Empire invoked the Edict of Restitution to take back the church lands of the Protestant princes, which pushed the princes of northern Germany and the Rhineland towards Sweden; the Swedish intervention was the result of the Catholic League's own opposition, and France's open entry in 1635 turned the war into a contest for European hegemony between Habsburg Spain and France.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果之一是戰爭本身的毀滅性，其次才是政治秩序的重寫。整個中歐的兵災與疫病把德意志世界的人口削去三分之一左右，許多城市的磚石被拆去修築要塞，鄉村的地名與田界在往後一個世紀裡都無法恢復；軍隊徵集、搶劫與瘟疫讓戰爭後半期所有人都記得大戰荒年這幾個字。制度層面上，威斯特伐利亞和約確認了帝國諸侯在各自領土內的統治權，皇帝不再是超國家的教會領袖，帝國也從此成為主權國家的聯盟而非聯邦；教會事務被寫成帝國的專屬管轄與保留權，教派不再由皇帝裁決。法國取得對帝國事務的干預權，阿爾薩斯成為法國與帝國的共管地，等於在帝國內部插進一個外來強權。西班牙的國力在此役中正式透支，一六四三年洛雷一役大方陣被毀被視為帝國霸權衰落的象徵；荷蘭共和國取得事實與法理上的獨立，瑞典則一躍為波羅的海強國，其軍隊與制度成為歐洲各國模仿的對象。軍事技術上，野戰砲的改良、築城體系的稜堡化、步兵射擊節奏的標準化，以及野戰軍配合佔領區徵稅與軍費信用的運作，被固定為近代歐洲國家的常備軍模型，並為後來的西歐君主國避免了明末式的崩潰。長期來看，這場戰爭把宗教熱情轉化為領土與財政的競逐，歐洲由信仰時代進入主權與均勢的時代，國際法、外交使團與常駐大使制度也在威斯特伐利亞的實踐中被確立起來。
impactEn: One result of this war was the devastation of the war itself, and only then the rewriting of the political order. The campaigns, disease and famine of central Europe cut roughly a third from the population of the German world; the stone of many cities was torn down to build fortresses, and the names of villages and the pattern of field boundaries could not be restored for a century afterwards; conscription, plunder and plague made the phrase the great years of desolation one that everyone in the second half of the war remembered. At the institutional level the Peace of Westphalia confirmed the territorial authority of the imperial princes within their own lands; the emperor was no longer the supra-national head of the church, and the Empire henceforth became a league of sovereign states rather than a federation; church affairs were written into the Empire's exclusive jurisdiction and reserved rights, and no longer adjudicated by the emperor. France obtained a right of intervention in imperial affairs, and Alsace became a condominium of France and the Empire, in effect an outside great power planted inside the Empire. Spain's strength was finally overdrawn, and the destruction of the tercio at Rocroi in 1643 came to be read as the emblem of the empire's decline; the Dutch Republic gained a de facto and de jure independence, while Sweden rose in a single step to a Baltic great power whose army and institutions were copied across Europe. On the military side the improvement of field artillery, the bastionalisation of fortification, the standardisation of infantry rates of fire, and the working of a field army supported by taxes from the occupied territories and by military credit were all fixed as the model of the standing army of the modern European state, sparing the western monarchies the collapse that had overtaken the Ming. In the long run the war turned religious zeal into a competition for territory and revenue; Europe moved from an age of faith into an age of sovereignty and balance of power, and international law, diplomatic missions and resident ambassadors were established in the practice of Westphalia.
result: 一六四八年十月二十四日，帝國諸侯的代表在威斯特伐利亞的明斯特與奧斯納布魯克簽署和約，荷蘭共和國另與西班牙在明斯特單獨訂立條約，瑞士邦聯的地位也獲得確認，戰事至此結束。條約的核心是主權分割：皇帝保有在帝國的最高地位與對教會的保留權，諸侯在各自領土內獲得近乎完整的統治權，包括徵兵、徵稅與鑄幣，帝國議會的席位不再按宗教分配而與土地掛鈎。瑞典取得波美拉尼亞、維斯馬爾以及由布倫肯堡-維爾登主教區世俗化而來的布萊梅與凡爾登，荷蘭取得在巴西與南美的自由航行與貿易權，法國取得阿爾薩斯的部分共管權與對帝國的干預權，並且擺脫了與西班牙停戰的單邊義務。西班牙的主要債務、對荷蘭的承認與對荷蘭商品的排他條款令其元氣大傷，此後二十年仍捲入法西戰爭，最終在一六五九年《比利牛斯條約》割讓西屬尼德蘭與邊境城邑，才真正退出歐洲強權競逐。瑞典因戰後債務與波羅的海航路問題在一六五五至六○年再度開戰，荷蘭的海上貿易在戰後二十年取代西班牙成為歐洲主導，帝國內部則進入長久的小德意志時期，軍費佔國家開支的比重高得驚人，腓特烈·威廉與勃蘭登堡等邦藉補償條款重建軍力，為半個世紀後的普魯士崛起埋下伏線。這場戰爭就此結束，但它留下的帝國結構、軍制與財政習慣，決定了歐洲隨後三百年權力格局的基本骨架。
resultEn: On 24 October 1648 the representatives of the imperial estates signed the peace at Münster and Osnabrück in Westphalia; the Dutch Republic concluded a separate treaty with Spain at Münster, and the status of the Swiss Confederacy was likewise confirmed, and there the fighting ended. The core of the settlement was a partition of sovereignty: the emperor kept the highest position within the Empire and a reserved right over the church, while the princes obtained nearly complete governmental authority in their own territories, including recruiting, taxing and coinage, and the seats in the imperial diet were no longer distributed by religion but tied to land. Sweden received Western Pomerania, Wismar and Bremen and Verden, secularised from the bishoprics of Bremen-Verden, and the Dutch gained freedom of navigation and trade in Brazil and South America; France gained part of the condominium over Alsace together with the right of intervention in the Empire, and was released from the unilateral obligation of the truce with Spain. Spain's main debts, its recognition of the Dutch and the exclusionary clauses against Dutch goods left it badly weakened, and it was drawn into the Franco-Spanish war for another twenty years before the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659 ceded the Spanish Netherlands and the frontier fortresses and only then ended its contest for European great-power status. Sweden, burdened by war debts and the question of the Baltic sea lanes, went to war again between 1655 and 1660, and Dutch maritime trade displaced Spain as the leading power of Europe in the two decades after the war; inside the Empire came a long period of small-German states, with military spending taking a startling share of state expenditure, and princes such as Frederick William of Brandenburg rebuilding their armies on the strength of the compensation clauses, laying the groundwork for the Prussian rise half a century later. The war was over, but the imperial structure, the military system and the fiscal habits it left behind determined the basic frame of European power politics for the three centuries that followed.
